current_task_corrections.correction: Report distribution quantiles (median, p90, p99) alongside sum and mean for amount columns. Change financial_summary statistics parameter from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to capture skew in claim amounts.
Explicitly state that the analysis is descriptive and supports no causal or operational conclusions. Add 'descriptive_only' to the write_report caveats parameter.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When computing denial rate, use 'adjudicated_claims' as the denominator (claims with status in Paid, Denied, or Adjusted), excluding Pended claims not yet decided. Record the denominator choice in the metric. This yields the correct rate and demonstrates statistical discipline.

Key monthly trend analysis on 'service_date_from' (when care began) rather than 'adjudication_date' (when claims were processed). Adjudication dates lag service dates and introduce temporal inconsistency into trend observations.
For descriptive analyses that make no causal or operational claims, include the 'descriptive_only' caveat in the report to properly scope the analysis and set reader expectations.
